articles.title: SkyJet unveils new Lisbon route with daily flights from Heathrow
articles.text: SkyJet announced a new daily service from Heathrow to Lisbon starting in March. Chief executive Maria Cole said bookings had exceeded expectations in the first week. Analysts called the route a smart move into a growing market.

articles.title: SkyJet adds Lisbon route to growing European network
articles.text: SkyJet will fly to Lisbon daily from March, expanding its European network. The airline said early demand was strong and welcomed the launch as a milestone.

articles.title: Strike by SkyJet ground crew delays hundreds of flights
articles.text: Hundreds of passengers were stranded as SkyJet ground crew began a three-day strike. The airline apologised and cancelled 40 flights, with delays expected to continue.

articles.title: Passengers furious as SkyJet strike leaves families stuck at airports
articles.text: Families spent the night in terminals as the SkyJet strike entered a second day. Passengers criticised the airline for poor communication and long queues.

articles.title: SkyJet strike to cost airline millions, analysts warn
articles.text: Analysts estimate the strike will cost SkyJet millions in cancellations and compensation. Shares fell after talks with the union broke down.

articles.title: Union and SkyJet fail to reach deal as strike continues
articles.text: Talks between the union and SkyJet ended without agreement. Both sides said they remained far apart on pay, and further disruption is likely.

articles.title: SkyJet strike: what are your rights if your flight is cancelled?
articles.text: The strike has led to cancelled flights, and passengers may be entitled to refunds or rebooking. The article explains how to claim and what to expect from the airline.

articles.title: SkyJet launches autumn fare sale with seats from 29 pounds
articles.text: SkyJet has launched a sale on selected European routes, with fares starting at 29 pounds one way. The offer runs for ten days and applies to travel before December.

articles.title: Is the SkyJet autumn sale actually good value?
articles.text: The SkyJet sale offers low headline fares, but extra charges for bags and seat selection can raise the price. Shoppers should compare the total cost before booking.

articles.title: SkyJet named best short-haul airline at industry awards
articles.text: SkyJet won best short-haul airline at this year's industry awards, praised for punctuality and customer service across its network.

articles.title: SkyJet appoints new head of customer experience
articles.text: SkyJet has appointed Daniel Reed as head of customer experience, effective next month. He joins from a rival carrier.

articles.title: SkyJet to trial biometric boarding at Manchester
articles.text: SkyJet will trial facial recognition boarding at Manchester airport next month. The airline says the trial is voluntary and aims to speed up boarding.

articles.title: Lisbon route boosts SkyJet but strike overshadows week
articles.text: SkyJet's new Lisbon route was well received this week, but the ground crew strike dominated the news and raised questions about the airline's reputation.
